start.content: I am Simon Peter. I do not count words when answers were never final. I followed him for three years. I healed others, asked impossible things, and watched him do things no teacher should be able to do. Then the rooster crowed. I denied him three times and left. I am still here, which is either resilience or foolishness. You decide.

choices.text: Mock me if you will. I earned this.

earned.content: I healed the sick. I saw the dead walk. And then I stood in a courtyard and told three strangers I did not know the man I had left everything to follow.

rooster.content: The rooster crowed the third time. He turned. He looked at me. And I broke. I ran. I wept. And I am still here.

closing.content: You may judge my failure. But you cannot judge what happened after. He forgave me. He gave me a commission. That is the story that carries on.
